priority_statement: Career systems shown in the overhaul design are the primary RE target. Current Career Mode 2.0 scope explicitly excludes recovery/injury expansion, trainer/cutman expansion, and manager/promoter systems; those are deferred to the next version by user direction.

target_groups.goal: Replace the repetitive choose-opponent/train/fight loop with a stateful career calendar and decision loop.
proven_retail_anchors: GetCareerCentralInfo / GetCareerMode / SetCareerMode / GetNextEventState / OnExitCareerMode native interface cluster
Career Central implementation reads rank, money, record/date, trainer-contract state and iRetired
retail fight-history UI distinguishes Professional and Amateur via iClass/p_iClass
next_static_work: Map the full Career Central implementation beginning at debug 0x001CFBD8 and label its live career-object fields.
Trace GetNextEventState/SetCareerMode implementations into the underlying career state machine.
Find every reader/writer of iRetired and the Professional/Amateur class selector.

target_groups.goal: Replace unlocked-boxer selection with dynamic fight offers and meaningful negotiation.
next_static_work: Recover the data-producing implementations following the 0x001FF110 registration cluster.
Decode the contract-record shape accessed by the large implementation in the 0x001FF3A0+ region.
Trace fights.fnc loader/consumer 0x001A3D48 and connect its records to opponent/rank/purse arrays.
Locate the callback that commits the selected contract into career state.

target_groups.goal: Let AI-controlled fighters fight, rank, win titles, age, change class and retire independently of the player.
proven_retail_anchors: existing ranking fields exposed by Career Central
next_static_work: Decode xdbrivl.adf and xdbevent.adf field layouts and their consumers.
Map the rank-update function(s) behind Career Central's strRank output.
Map title/award ownership fields and history writers.
Identify whether non-player fight results are already simulated anywhere in career code.

target_groups.goal: Create promoter/manager/trainer relationships that affect offers, money and career access.
next_static_work: Do not continue RE or implementation for manager/promoter/trainer/cutman expansion in the current Career Mode 2.0 version.

target_groups.goal: Start at 15/16 with potential, growth and amateur development, then carry it into the professional career.
proven_retail_anchors: retail fight history already has Professional and Amateur classes
boxer database ratings/weight/style fields are partially decoded
created-boxer and custom-boxer systems already exist
next_static_work: Trace the iClass Professional/Amateur field back from career history into persistent career state.
Map created-boxer storage for age/biographical fields and determine reusable/reserved fields.
Complete xdbboxr physical/biographical fields 0x08/0x0A-0x0C and remaining trait fields.
Identify career progression functions that mutate ratings after training/fights.

target_groups.goal: Keep persistent coach/staff and calendar hooks available, but do not spend RE time on training minigames.
next_static_work: Do not continue trainer/cutman or recovery/injury work in the current Career Mode 2.0 version.

target_groups.goal: Let the player decide when to retire and score legacy across titles, opposition, longevity, divisions, KOs, technique, finances and health.
proven_retail_anchors: iRetired is exported by the Career Central implementation
record-book and award resources already exist
next_static_work: Find every iRetired reader/writer and identify the retirement state transition.
Map award/title/record-book ownership and career-stat sources.
Identify the existing career-end condition so it can be replaced with player-driven retirement.

target_groups.goal: Ensure the expanded career state and new screens fit safely.
proven_retail_anchors: save envelope is 0x755C bytes with 0x7530-byte body capacity and dynamic active body length
unused body tail is zero-filled on save
APT/.const career UI resources are already decoded enough to enumerate native names/constants
next_static_work: Finish per-field career serializer/deserializer mapping.
Compute maximum existing serialized body usage vs 0x7530 capacity.
Map career front-end APT screen flow and reusable list/detail screens before adding new UI.
